caption: The drawing features a horizontal decorative border located near the center of the composition. The upper section of the border is a narrow red band that has a repeating linear design in a light taupe or beige color, interspersed with vertical rectangles containing short lines. Directly below, a wider green band contains ornamental yellow-gold geometric patterns and scrollwork. Within the green band, two stylized white flowers with small white dots appear, one toward the left side and one toward the right, each surrounded by the yellow-gold scrolls and green leafy accents. The background of the entire drawing, outside the border, is plain and unadorned off-white or beige. In the lower right corner of the page, the name "Walter Doran" is written in small, neat print.
title: Wallpaper Border
